title: Reproducibility materials for "Auditing Data-Repair Benchmarks with Explicit Comparison Contracts"
description: Protocols, author code, saved run evidence, predictions, scoring outputs and replay material for the article "Auditing Data-Repair Benchmarks with Explicit Comparison Contracts" (submitted to Information Systems). S1: reference experiment for supplied-authority conformance. S2: BART generator audit. S3: CSV-only matching control. S4: Raha/Baran consumer audit. S5: audit decision ledger. S6: figure code. S7: 90 extended BART generator runs with constraint-driven errors and a 50-row table. Third-party CSV files, YAML sources and upstream code are not redistributed; each folder explains how to restore them from pinned public sources.
